name: Cusity bot filter v3
selection: mean balanced validation accuracy over seeds; ties -> fewer gates
trainedOn: Hop airdrop Sybil list (ISC) and LayerZero initial Sybil list as bots, Hop bridge users as humans; wallets active on X Layer, snapshot block 76,254,000
limits: Only as honest as its inputs. Labels describe behaviour on other chains in 2022-2024, and the sources differ in era (every human is a 2022 Hop user; most bots are 2023-24 LayerZero), so some signal may be cohort, not behaviour: see test.by_source. Feature design and thresholds were chosen with the whole (unlabelled) feature distribution in view. Precision depends on how many bots a campaign really has: see test.bot_precision_at_prevalence. A filter result, not an accusation, and not a ban list. TapeOut's X Layer contracts are test-phase and unaudited.
